column7: Indicator Wording - FRA
column10: What is its Purpose?

column5: Amount of Greenhouse Gas Emissions Saved
column6: total amount of CO2 equivalent (in tonnes) reduced or avoided as a result of using the promoted [specify the measure] during [specify the period]
column7: quantité totale d'équivalent CO2 (en tonnes) réduite ou évitée du fait de l'utilisation de la [précisez la mesure] promue pendant [précisez la période]
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which an intervention contributed to climate change mitigation by reducing the amount of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2-eq) within the stated period. This can be achieved through reducing the usage of fossil fuels, reforestation, improved management of organic waste, reducing the use of fertilizers containing nitrogen and other high-impact measures.

column6: total amount of [specify the resource and unit] saved per [specify the time-frame] thanks to [specify the measure]
column7: montant total de [spécifiez la ressource et l’unité de mesure] économisé(e) par [spécifiez la période] grâce à [spécifiez la mesure]
column10: The indicator shows the extent to which the intervention sustainably reduced the use of natural or man-made resources within a given period. This can include fuel (firewood, charcoal, kerosene, petrol, etc.), electricity, water, food waste, plastic, construction materials and other resources whose use contributes to depleting the natural resource base.

column6: average life satisfaction score for [specify: women / men / others] aged [specify age range]
column7:
score moyen de satisfaction de la vie [spécifier : femmes/ hommes/ autres] âgé[e]s de [
préciser le groupe d'âge]
column10: This indicator measures people’s subjective satisfaction with their current lives – an important aspect of their well-being. It effectively complements other indicators of people’s well-being, such as their income or health.

column6: total amount of [specify the resource and unit] saved during [specify the time frame] thanks to the implemented environmental mainstreaming measures
column7: montant total de [préciser la ressource et l'unité] économisé pendant [préciser la période] grâce aux mesures d'intégration des questions environnementales mises en œuvre
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which an organisation (or one of its branches or a specific project) adjusted operations to use less of a particular resource, such as electricity (for lighting, air conditioning, heating), water, fuel (for vehicles, generators), gas (for heating), water, waste or packaging materials.

column6: % of target group members reported that the provided assistance met their priority needs
column7: % des membres du groupe cible qui déclarent que l'assistance fournie a répondu à leurs besoins prioritaires
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the people who received assistance think it meets their needs. It indicates the relevance of the provided assistance.

column6: increased financial disbursement by [specify the stakeholder] to address the advocated issue
column7: augmentation de l’engagement budgétaire de [préciser la partie prenante] pour traiter la question défendue
column10: The indicator measures any increase in the amount of money disbursed (e.g. by a local authority / company / another stakeholder) for addressing a given cause, as a result of the advocacy efforts.

column6: % of [specify the target group] who are female
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui sont des femmes
column10: This indicator measures the representation of women among the members of an intervention’s target group – for example, the percentage of female sales agents (however, where relevant, it can also focus on the representation of men).

column6: gender and age marks scored by the project
column7: notes de genre et d'âge obtenues par le projet
column10: IASC’s “Gender with Age Marker” and DG ECHO’s “Gender-Age Marker” are tools used to assess how well projects mainstream gender and age considerations and what their key opportunities for improvements are.

column5: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Avoided in Operations
column6: total amount of CO2 equivalent (in tonnes) avoided during [specify the time frame] thanks to the implemented environmental mainstreaming measures
column7: quantité totale d'équivalent CO2 (en tonnes) évitée pendant [préciser la période] grâce aux mesures d'intégration des questions environnementales mises en œuvre
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which an organisation (or one of its branches or a specific project) managed to reduce the amount of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2-eq) emitted due to its operations over a specific period. Reductions can be achieved by minimising the use of electricity, gas, fuel, and other resources whose production or use emits significant amounts of greenhouse gasses.

column5: Months of Adequate Household Food Provisioning
column6: the average duration of a period in the past 12 months when the target households had enough food to meet their members' needs
column7: la durée moyenne d'une période au cours des 12 derniers mois pendant laquelle les ménages cibles avaient suffisamment de nourriture pour répondre aux besoins de leurs membres
column10: There is a strong link between seasonally reoccurring hunger and child malnutrition. Reducing the duration of the "hunger gap" is among the best ways for lowering the prevalence of food insecurity and acute malnutrition.

column5: Perceived Effectiveness of Implemented Adaptation Measures
column6: % of [specify the target group] who think that the implemented measures have been effective in adapting to the local effects of climate change
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui pensent que les mesures mises en œuvre ont permis de s’adapter efficacement aux effets locaux des changements climatiques
column10: The indicator measures people’s perceptions of how effective the measures they used were for adapting to selected, locally visible, effects of climate change (e.g. droughts, floods). Although such data might be quite subjective. It provides insights into people’s experience and the likelihood of them using the measures are in the longer-term.

column5: Product / Service’s Perceived Contribution to Higher Production
column6: % of targeted producers reporting an increase in their production as a result of using [specify the types of services / products]
column7: % de producteurs cibles faisant état d’une augmentation de leur production résultant de l’utilisation de [spécifiez les types de services / produits]
column10: This indicator measures whether people who used the promoted service(s) / product(s) believe that their use has contributed to an increase in the production of the given goods (e.g. crops, animals, processed products, clothes and other goods). It is based on people’s perceptions, not on actual measurements. It is important to acknowledge that other factors (such as weather conditions) could have influenced the production levels.

column6: number or % of persons that gained employment and retained it for at least [specify the number] months
column7: nombre ou % de personnes ayant obtenu un emploi et l'ayant conservé pendant au moins [spécifiez le nombre] mois
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of people who gained new employment (part-time or full-time) and retained it for a pre-defined minimum of time. It is an important indicator showing the extent to which the job creation support was effective and can contribute to a longer-term improvement of people’s livelihoods.

column6: % of target group members reporting to be satisfied with the provided assistance
column7: % des membres du groupe cible qui se déclarent satisfaits de l'assistance fournie
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of the target group members who were satisfied with the provided assistance, especially its usefulness. It indicates the relevance and quality of the assistance.

column6: % of staff that understand the key principles and practices of environmental mainstreaming
column7: % des membres du personnel qui comprend les principes et pratiques clés de l'intégration des questions environnementales
column10: The indicator assesses to what extent the staff (of an organisation or a specific project only) understand the key principles and practices of environmental mainstreaming. It indicates the extent to which they can support the effective implementation of environmental mainstreaming measures. The indicator can also highlight the need for (further) staff training on specific topics relating to environmental mainstreaming. It can be used both in the context of environmental mainstreaming in operations and in project activities.

column6: number or % of targeted [specify the target group] using the promoted [specify the energy technology]
column7: nombre ou % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] ayant recours à la [spécifiez la technologie énergétique promue
column10: The indicator measures the number (or proportion) of the target group members that use the promoted types of climate-smart energy technologies. This includes technologies that either serve as eco-friendly sources of energy (solar lamps or biodigesters) or those that reduce the consumption of environmentally unsustainable energy sources (such as fuel-efficient stoves or housing insulation).

column6: the average number of different food groups consumed by women of reproductive age (15 - 49 years) the previous day or night
column7: le nombre moyen des différents groupes d'aliments consommés par les femmes en âge de procréer (15 à 49 ans) le jour ou la nuit précédents
column10: The indicator assesses the number of (pre-determined) food groups which were eaten by a woman the previous day or night. It indicates changes in the micronutrient adequacy of women's diets, one important dimension of diet quality.

column6: average % of target households’ [specify the animal] which suffered from [specify the disease] during the past [specify the number] months
column7: % moyen de [indiquer l'animal]  des ménages cibles qui ont souffert de [précisez la maladie] au cours des [précisez le nombre] derniers mois
column10: The indicator measures the prevalence of a specific disease amongst certain animals, for example, foot-and-mouth disease among cows. It is an indicator of animal care and the presence of health and life-threatening disease.

column6: the average Benefit Score (1-10) given by [specify the service users] on the usefulness of [specify the service provider]'s services
column7: la note moyenne de Prestations (1-10) donnée par [précisez les utilisateurs du service] sur l'utilité des services de [précisez le prestataire de services]
column10: The indicator assesses the extent to which the respondents are satisfied with the usefulness of the services delivered to them by the supported service providers. The indicator is based on a subjective judgment of a range of quality and access-related features of the provided services.

column6: % of MEAL activities where the collected data is disaggregated by gender and age
column7: % d'activités MEAL pour lesquelles les données collectées sont ventilées par genre et par âge
column10: This indicator shows the extent to which a project’s monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning (MEAL) activities disaggregate the collected data by gender and age. It indicates the extent to which project teams are enabled to understand the situation of specific sections of the target population.

column6: % of MEAL activities where the collected data is disaggregated by gender and age
column7: % d'activités MEAL pour lesquelles les données collectées sont ventilées par genre et par âge
column10: This indicator shows the extent to which a project’s monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning (MEAL) activities disaggregate the collected data by gender and age. It indicates the extent to which project teams are enabled to understand the situation of specific sections of the target population.

column6: increased use of environmentally friendly construction materials and methods
column7: utilisation accrue de matériaux et de méthodes de construction respectueux de l'environnement
column10: This qualitative indicator indicates that the project used more environmentally-friendly construction materials and methods compared to standard (re)construction practices in the given area and context. It is intended for humanitarian contexts where exact quantifications of the environmental benefits might not be feasible.

column6: % of [specify the project activity] with a desirable ratio of female and male participants
column7: % de [spécifier l'activité du projet] avec une proportion souhaitable de participants féminins et masculins
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which women / men are adequately represented in a given project activity, such as community groups or training. The indicator is most useful for activities implemented on a large scale (e.g. dozens or hundreds of trainings) and for which you can record the number of male and female participants.

column6: % of [specify the project activity] with a desirable ratio of female and male participants
column7: % de [spécifier l'activité du projet] avec une proportion souhaitable de participants féminins et masculins
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which women / men are adequately represented in a given project activity, such as community groups or training. The indicator is most useful for activities implemented on a large scale (e.g. dozens or hundreds of trainings) and for which you can record the number of male and female participants.

column6: % of [specify the target group] who adapted their marketing practices to reach [choose: female / male] customers more effectively
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui ont adaptés leurs pratiques commerciales pour atteindre plus efficacement les clients [choisir : femmes / hommes]
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of the targeted service providers / sellers / sales agents / other businesses who adapted their marketing practices in a way that enables them to reach female / male customers more effectively. It is an indicator of how gender-sensitive the marketing practices are (i.e. meeting better the needs of potential female / male customers).

column6: % of [specify the target group] who do not [specify the target behaviour] but plan to do so in the following [specify the time frame]
column7: % de [spécifier le groupe cible] qui ne [spécifier le comportement cible] mais ont l’intention de le faire dans le[s] prochain[s] [spécifier la période de temps]
column10: This indicator measures the proportion of the target population that does not practice a certain behaviour but intends to do so in the near future. The indicator is especially useful for evaluating the effectiveness of social and behaviour change (SBC) communication activities.

column6: number of households receiving cash transfers in the planned amount
column7: nombre de ménages recevant des transferts d’argent selon le montant prévu
column10: This indicator shows the number of households that have received support through cash transfers or vouchers.

column6: % of target group members that perceive [specify the product] as easy to use
column7: % de membres du groupe cible qui considèrent [spécifier le produit] comme facile d’emploi
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of targeted group members (either product users or non-users) who think that the promoted product is easy to use. Such products can, for example, include a domestic biodigester, a digital payment system, or crop processing equipment. The extent to which people perceive a product as easy to use has a significant impact on its usage and commercial take-up.

column5: Perceived Effectiveness of Promoted Adaptation Measures
column6: % of [specify the target group] who think that the promoted measures are effective in adapting to the local effects of climate change
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui pensent que les mesures promues permettent de s’adapter efficacement aux effets locaux des changements climatiques
column10: The indicator measures people’s perceptions of how effective the promoted measures are in adapting to selected, locally-visible effects of climate change (e.g. droughts, floods). Such data is very important, as people are not likely to adopt measures that – in their opinion – do not work. The data can help you design the focus of your promotion activities and evaluate their effectiveness.

column6: % of staff trained on the principles and practices of environmental mainstreaming in the past [specify number] months
column7: % des membres du personnel formé aux principes et pratiques de l'intégration des questions environnementales au cours des [préciser le nombre] derniers mois
column10: This basic indicator shows the proportion of staff (of an organisation or a specific project only) who were trained on the principles and practices of environmental mainstreaming. It should always be complemented by an indicator assessing their actual understanding of environmental mainstreaming. It can be used both in the context of environmental mainstreaming in operations as well as project activities.

column6: number or % of [specify: producers / sellers / service providers] that have in the past [specify the number of months] used at least [specify a number or %] of promoted marketing practices
column7: nombre ou % de [producteurs / vendeurs / prestataires de services] qui ont pendant [spécifiez le nombre de mois] passés utilisé au moins [spécifiez le nombre ou le %] de pratiques commerciales promues
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the target sellers / service providers adopted the promoted marketing practices, such as inviting existing users of a technology to a promotional meeting to share their experience; cooperating with other producers to sell their produce; or customizing sales messages based on the target group and their preferences (e.g. different messaging for women and men).

column6: % of farming households whose members started cooperating on their [specify: production / marketing / advocacy] efforts and gained tangible benefits
column7: % de ménages agricoles dont les membres ont commencé à joindre leurs efforts de [spécifier: production/ marketing/ plaidoyer] et en ont obtenu des bénéfices tangibles
column10: The indicator measures the number of farming households whose members started cooperating on improving their production or marketing or advocacy efforts and gained tangible benefits from such cooperation.

column6: % of [specify the profession] in the targeted areas that are women
column7: % de [spécifiez la profession] dans les zones ciblées qui sont des femmes
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of the female workforce in a given profession and geographical area. It is suitable for interventions aiming to increase women’s involvement and representation in the targeted professions.

column6: % of planned environmental mainstreaming measures that were implemented
column7: % des mesures d'intégration des questions environnementales prévues qui ont été mises en œuvre
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which the planned measures for mainstreaming environmental protection were adequately implemented. It is one of the key environmental mainstreaming indicators.  It can be used both in the context of the operations and project activities.

column6: % of respondents who prefer purchasing the local types of the promoted products as opposed to the imported ones
column7: % de répondants qui préfèrent acheter les variétés locales des produits promus plutôt que les produits importés
column10: This indicator is useful in situations when an intervention aims to promote the sales of locally produced products (e.g. certain types of organic vegetables) or inputs (e.g. feeds or fertilizers) as opposed to products that are imported from other regions and countries. Such data is essential for understanding the extent to which the produce of the local producers can compete with the imports (that are often managed by larger companies).

column5: Provision of Embedded Services to Customers
column6: number or % of sellers providing embedded [select: advisory / transportation ... ] services
column7: nombre ou % de vendeurs offrant des services intégrés de [spécifiez: conseil / transport / … ]
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of businesses that provide their customers with complementary, free of charge services, as part of their transactional relationship. For example, sellers of agricultural inputs providing advice to customers on how to use their seeds and fertilizers; solar energy suppliers providing promo materials and training to shops selling their products; or sellers of materials for toilet construction offering transport.

column6: number or % of farmers who for the past [specify the duration] followed the promoted [specify the practice] on their farms
column7: nombre ou % d'agriculteurs qui, pendant les [précisez la durée] passés, ont appliqué [précisez la pratique] promue dans leurs fermes
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion or number of farmers who started, and for a minimum period of time at least, continued to follow the promoted agricultural practice. It is a crucial sign of the extension services’ effectiveness. The long-term use of the promoted practices is also the best indication of their sustainability.

column6: % of supported farmers who increased the productivity of their [specify the crop or animal] production
column7: % des agriculteurs appuyés qui ont augmenté la productivité de leur production de [spécifier la culture ou l'animal]
column10: The indicator measures the ratio of agricultural outputs (e.g. tons of crops or number of animals) to the invested inputs (primarily money but also labor or water). Increasing agricultural productivity is essential for ensuring adequate nutrition of the ever-growing population; however, such changes should not be at the expense of environmental sustainability.

column6: average / total amount of production of [specify the product] in the past [specify the period]
column7: moyenne / montant total de la production de [spécifiez le produit] pendant [spécifiez la période] passée
column10: This is a basic supply indicator measuring the quantity of a given product (e.g. metric tons of a certain type of crop / litres of sunflower oil / number of fuel-efficient stoves) produced by the target group members over a set period of time.

column5: Area of Degraded Land Under Sustainable Management
column6: number of hectares of the target land that is effectively managed by formal and informal natural resources protection measures
column7: nombre d'hectares des terres ciblées qui sont gérées efficacement par des mesures formelles et informelles de protection des ressources naturelles
column10: The indicator assesses the total area of degraded land (including forests, pastures, fields, etc.) that is effectively protected against further degradation. The protection can be ensured by community bylaws, regulations enforced by relevant authorities, individual farmers applying soil protection measures and other means.

column5: Area of Land Under Improved Management
column6: hectares of land managed using environmentally sustainable practices
column7: hectares de terres gérées selon des pratiques soutenables vis à vis de l’environnement
column10: The indicator assesses the total area of land (including forests, pastures, fields, etc.) that are managed using environmentally beneficial practices, such as the application of organic inputs, use of minimum tillage, planting of cover crops, use of bylaws / regulations and other environmentally sustainable and economically viable practices.

column6: the average number of crop types grown by the target households during the last [specify the name of the season]
column7: le nombre moyen de types de cultures cultivées par les ménages cibles au cours de la dernière [précisez le nom de la saison]
column10: The indicator measures the diversity of farming households’ crop production. Crop diversity is important for ensuring people’s access to nutritious food and for supporting the diversity of the local agro-ecosystems.

column6: at least X out of Y Landscape Management Plans fulfilled the required minimum of their targets
column7: au moins X plans de gestion du paysage sur Y ont atteint le minimum requis de leurs objectifs
column10: A Landscape Management Plan is a document outlining what will be done, by whom and by when, to rehabilitate and protect natural resources in a given area. The Plans are designed in close cooperation between local community members, extension workers and the relevant authorities. The indicator assesses the number of Landscape Management Plans which achieved a minimum proportion of their targets set for a given period (usually several months before a project ends).

column6: number of communities with an effective natural resources management structure in place
column7: nombre de collectivités ayant une structure de gestion des ressources naturelles efficace
column10: The indicator assesses the number of communities with an effective system for managing their local natural resources.

column6: % of reference plots in the target areas with improved levels of [specify: organic matter content / soil structure / pH / or specify the exact nutrient(s)]
column7: % de parcelles de référence dans les zones cibles avec des niveaux améliorés de [spécifier: teneur en matière organique / structure du sol / pH / ou spécifier le(s) nutriment(s) ex
column10: The indicator assesses selected aspects of soil quality in the project target areas. It is suitable for interventions addressing a specific deficiency in the soil condition.

column6: % of supported [specify the target group] that are still operational [specify the time] from when they received support
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] appuyés qui sont opérationnels [spécifiez le temps] après avoir été appuyés
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of supported businesses that are still operational after a certain period since receiving support. Its purpose is to show the sustainability of the provided assistance. The indicator is especially important for projects supporting start-ups, where the survival rate often drops below 50% in the first four years.

column6: number or % of [specify the target group] that use the promoted environmentally-friendly [specify: practices / services / products]
column7: nombre ou % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] ayant recours aux [spécifiez: pratiques/ services/ produits] respectueux de l’environnement promus
column10: The indicator measures the number or proportion of the target group members that started using those promoted environmentally friendly practices / services / products that contribute to more sustainable consumption and production. This includes any practices / services / products whose use minimizes the usage of natural resources and toxic materials as well as the emissions of waste and pollutants over the life cycle of the service / product (e.g. using energy-efficient products; reducing, reusing and recycling materials; decreasing the usage of harmful chemicals; etc.).

column6: % of [specify the target group] who follow the promoted water-saving measures
column7: % de [préciser le groupe cible] qui suivent les mesures d'économie d'eau promues
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which the target group members follow the promoted ways of using water more efficiently.

column6: average % of target households’ [specify the animal] which died during the past [specify number] months
column7: % moyen de [précisez l'animal] des ménages cibles qui sont décédés au cours des [précisez le nombre] mois passés
column10: Animal mortality rate is an important indicator of the quality of care provided to raised animals and the severity of external factors, such as disease outbreaks or droughts.

column6: number of hectares of agriculture land in the project target area affected by surface erosion
column7: nombre d'hectares de terres agricoles affectées par l'érosion de surface dans les zones cibles du projet
column10: The indicator quantifies the total area of the targeted agricultural land that is affected by surface erosion. When using the indicator, focus only on those productive agricultural lands (fields, pastures and forests) where recent farming practices caused surface erosion (which your intervention aimed to reduce).

column6: average yield of [specify the crop] per [specify the unit – m2, acre, hectare] achieved by the target households
column7: rendement moyen de [spécifiez la culture] par [spécifier l'unité - m2, acre, hectare] atteint par les ménages cibles
column10: The indicator measures the households’ average yield of a given crop per unit area of land (usually kilograms per hectare), as reported by the households’ members.

column6: % of target farmers who grew [specify the crop] during [specify the season and/ or the time period]
column7: % des agriculteurs ciblés qui ont cultivé [précisez la culture] pendant [précisez la saison et / ou la période]
column10: This indicator measures the proportion of households who during a given period grew a particular crop.

column6: % of target farmers who raise [specify the animal]
column7: % des agriculteurs ciblés qui élèvent [précisez l'animal]
column10: This indicator measures the proportion of households who raise a particular type of domestic animal.

column6: number of [specify the unit - hectares/jeribs…] of land planted with [specify the crop]
column7: nombre de [précisez l'unité - hectares / djeribs ...] de terres ensemencées avec [indiquer la culture]
column10: The indicator measures the area of land planted with a specific crop. A modified version can also be used to assess the area of land managed with a specific technique or technology (see the comments section below). It is essential for determining the acceptance and potential results of the promoted agronomic practices.

column6: % of target farmers who reported incurring crop production losses during the last season (caused by the most serious, pre-identified factors)
column7: % des agriculteurs ciblés qui ont déclaré avoir subi des pertes de production pendant la dernière saison (causés par les facteurs les plus graves et pré-identifiés)
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of supported farmers who during the last season experienced crop production loses caused by one or more of the most serious, pre-identified factors (such as specific diseases, insects or weeds). At the baseline stage, it helps with narrowing down the project's focus. At the endline stage, it shows the extent to which the project enabled farmers to address the main causes of production-related problems.

column6: % of surviving seedlings at end of [specify the time-frame]
column7: % de semis survivants à la fin de [précisez la période]
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of seedlings in the affected areas that survived for a certain period. It indicates the effectiveness of measures aiming to increase the use of trees or bushes.

column6: average [choose: weight/number] of [specify the crop/animal] produced by the target households [specify the time period]
column7: moyenne [choisir: poids / nombre] de [spécifiez la culture / animal] produit par les ménages cibles [précisez la période]
column10: The indicator assesses the average agricultural output of a certain crop / animal type produced by the target households during a specific period (as reported by the households’ members). It shows whether the households reached a higher output (which might lead to more income and better nutrition); however, it does not explain how the change was achieved (e.g. by expanding the field size; using a new technology; increasing the yields).

column6: % of target farmers who experienced post-harvest losses due to poor storage of crops after the [specify the season]
column7: % des agriculteurs ciblés qui ont subi des pertes après récolte en raison d'un mauvais entreposage des cultures après [précisez la saison]
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of supported households whose stores of certain crops were affected by pests or diseases. Inadequate storage is one of the main causes of post-production losses, accounting for up to 10% of losses to a household’s harvest.

column6: the extent to which the key recommendations from an environmental assessment were followed
column7: mesure dans laquelle les recommandations clés d'une évaluation environnementale ont été suivies
column10: The indicator shows the extent to which relevant staff used the recommendations provided by a completed environmental assessment that identified environmental risks and proposed risk mitigation measures. It indicates the extent to which the intervention considered environmental protection in its design and implementation.

column6: number of people positively impacted by the results of the project's advocacy initiatives
column7: nombre de personnes positivement impactées par les résultats des initiatives de plaidoyer du projet
column10: This indicator intends to give a realistic estimate of how many people have benefited from the changes achieved by the project’s advocacy efforts. It should only be used when a project team is confident that it is possible to quantify the number of people benefiting.

column6: % of target group members needing [specify the offered service] who have accessed it in the past [specify the timeframe]
column7: % des membres du groupe cible ayant besoin de [préciser le service offert] qui y ont eu accès dans le passé [préciser la période]
column10: There are many services that can considerably improve people’s lives, such as health / social protection / agricultural services. Therefore, this important coverage indicator shows the extent to which the target group members have used a given service during a certain period.

column6: number of recommendations for [define the purpose] that were adopted by relevant decision-makers
column7: nombre de recommandations pour [définir l’objet] qui ont été adoptées par les décideurs concernés
column10: This indicator measures how successful a project’s advocacy efforts were in ensuring that their recommendations are adopted by relevant decision-makers. The recommendations do not need to be concerned with high-level policy changes only – they can be about the work that the public and private actors are doing at the district or regional levels (e.g. how certain policies are implemented or services provided).

column6: a platform for holding a regular dialogue is institutionalized between public and private sector actors to agree on measures to [specify the purpose of the platform]
column7: une plate-forme de dialogue régulier est institutionnalisée entre les acteurs des secteurs public et privé pour convenir des mesures visant à [préciser l'objectif de la plate-forme]
column10: The indicator measures whether a supported platform is institutionalized and operational so as to allow public (e.g. local authorities, civil society organizations, citizens) and private (businesses) actors to agree on measures to tackle a given issue. For example, to improve the availability of certain products / services; to make the business registration process easier; etc. The indicator can be changed to focus on dialogue between different private sector actors.

column6: % of target group members actively participating in [specify the activity]
column7: % de membres du groupe cible participant activement à [spécifier l'activité]
column10: This essential indicator shows the extent to which the target group members actively participate in a given project activity, such as training or community group meetings. It encompasses two important pre-conditions for ensuring that a given activity is effective: First, the target group members are participating. Second, they participate actively in a way that is more likely to bring the desired results.

column5: Awareness of How to Participate in Activities
column6: % of target group members aware of how they can participate in relevant project activities
column7: % de membres du groupe cible conscients de la manière dont ils peuvent participer aux activités pertinentes du projet
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which the target group members know how they can participate in the project activities that are available to them, such as training or community groups.

column6: % of targeted farmers aware of the promoted [specify: climate-smart / sustainable / other] agronomic practices and their main benefits
column7: % d'agriculteurs ciblés connaissant les pratiques agronomiques promues [précisez: climato-compatibles / durables / autres] et leurs principaux avantages
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of target farmers who are aware of the promoted agronomic practices and their main benefits (a similar indicator can be used for any other target group). Such data helps you design the focus of your promotion activities and evaluate their effectiveness and reach.

column5: Engagement in Identifying Needs and Solutions
column6: number of communities whose members were actively engaged in identifying needs and designing solutions
column7: nombre de communautés dont les membres ont participé activement à l'identification des besoins et à la proposition de solutions
column10: The indicator indicates the extent to which the project actively engaged people from different areas in defining what needs the project should address and how.

column6: number of engagements with relevant decision-makers regarding the advocacy efforts
column7: nombre d'engagements avec des décideurs pertinents concernant les efforts de plaidoyer
column10: This indicator shows the extent to which the project team members engage with relevant decision-makers who can influence the results of the advocacy efforts.

column6: % of [specify the target group] with a favourable attitude towards [specify the behaviour]
column7: % de [spécifier le groupe cible] ayant une attitude favorable vis-à-vis de [spécifier le comportement]
column10: People’s existing attitudes influence their willingness to adopt the behaviours promoted by humanitarian and development interventions. This indicator therefore measures the proportion of the target population with a favourable attitude towards a promoted behaviour.

column6: number of people reached by the advocacy campaign
column7: nombre de personnes touchées par la campagne de sensibilisation
column10: This indicator shows the extent to which the advocacy campaign and its key messages reached members of the public. It is relevant for campaigns where reaching a more significant number of people is vital for achieving objectives.

column6: % of targeted farmers who think that the promoted practices are effective
column7: % d'agriculteurs ciblés qui pensent que les pratiques promues sont efficaces
column10: The indicator measures people’s perceptions of how effective the promoted agronomic practices are. Such data is very important, as people are not likely to adopt practices that – in their opinion – do not work. The data can help you design the focus of your promotion activities and evaluate their effectiveness.

column6: number of planned policy / public events delivered
column7: nombre d'événements politiques / publics prévus et réalisés
column10: This indicator reports on the number of policy or public events delivered to achieve the advocacy objectives. The events can range from discreet meetings with decision-makers (e.g. a roundtable on a given topic) to the mass mobilisation of the general public to influence a political stance (e.g. a public protest).

column6: % of MEAL activities that shared the collected data with relevant community members
column7: % des activités MEAL dont les données collectées ont été partagées avec les membres de la communauté concernés
column10: The indicator shows the extent to which an organization shared the most relevant findings of monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning (MEAL) activities with relevant community members. Regularly sharing the collected data and results and discussing their implications for further programming can strengthen community trust, ownership, and participation. It also enables the organization to validate the findings and verify the relevance of any planned follow-up actions.

column5: Adoption of the Promoted Management Practices
column6: number or % of [specify the target group] that use at least [specify a number or %] of promoted management practices
column7: nombre ou % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui utilisent au moins [spécifiez un nombre ou %] de pratiques de gestion promues
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the target sellers / service providers adopted the promoted business management practices, such as specific methods of financial management (e.g. recording business expenses and income, keeping the businesses’ funds in a bank account) or strategic planning (e.g. preparation of a business plan).

column6: % of [specify the target group] that actively use at least [specify number] of the promoted technologies
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui utilisent activement au moins [spécifiez le nombre] des technologies promues
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which were the promoted technologies adopted by the target businesses. Such technologies can include, for example, solar technologies used to ensure product quality (e.g. a fridge for a vet shop to store vaccines), a mobile application linking producers to buyers of their products, or improved drying technologies that allow for value to be added to vegetable production.

column6: increased budgetary commitment by [specify the stakeholder] to address the advocated issue
column7: augmentation des dépenses de fonds par [préciser la partie prenante] pour traiter la question défendue
column10: This indicator measures any changes to the amount of money budgeted by a given stakeholder (e.g. a local authority or a company) in addressing a given issue highlighted by the advocacy efforts.

column6: number of individuals benefiting from the supported self-help groups
column7: nombre d'individus bénéficiant des groupes d'entraide appuyés
column10: The indicator measures the number of people who benefit (or are likely to benefit) from the services provided by the supported self-help groups.

column6: number of self-help groups focused on strengthening their users' preparedness for shocks that perform at least [specify the percentage] of their functions
column7: nombre de groupes d'entraide axés sur le renforcement de leurs utilisateurs à la préparation aux chocs qui accomplissent au moins [précisez le %] de leurs fonctions
column10: The indicator measures the number of self-help groups that perform a minimum percentage of their most important functions. It focuses on self-help groups that strengthen people's preparedness to shocks, such as burial societies or saving groups.

column6: % of [specify the target group] who practice the promoted environmental protection practices
column7: % de [préciser le groupe cible] qui mettent en pratique les mesures de protection de l'environnement promues
column10: This indicator shows the extent to which the people targeted by environmental mainstreaming (such as the project staff) follow the promoted environmental practices.

column6: % of [specify the target group] who follow the promoted measures for reducing the use of unsustainable sources of energy
column7: % de [préciser le groupe cible] qui suit les mesures promues pour réduire l'utilisation de sources d'énergie non durables
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which the target group members follow the promoted ways of reducing the use of unsustainable energy sources, such as coal, oil, or unsustainably sourced biomass. Reduction can be achieved by 1) energy efficiency measures that reduce the amount of energy needed (such as fuel-efficient stoves, energy-efficient lighting or housing insulation); or 2) measures that replace unsustainable sources of energy with more eco-friendly sources (such as solar lamps, solar water pumps or domestic biodigesters).

column6: % of [specify the target group] who follow the promoted fuel-efficient cooking practices
column7: % de [préciser le groupe cible] qui suivent les pratiques promues pour une cuisine économe en combustible
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the target group members follow the promoted ways of reducing the volume of cooking fuel (e.g. charcoal, wood, gas, etc.).

column6: % of respondents aware of the promoted [specify the climate-smart energy technology] and its main benefits
column7: % de répondants connaissant la [spécifiez la technologie climato-compatible face au climat] et ses principaux avantages
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of the target group members who are aware of the promoted climate-smart energy technologies (such as solar lamps, domestic biodigesters, improved cooking stoves, or building insulations) and the benefits they provide. The data helps you design your promotion activities and evaluate their effectiveness and reach.

column5: Awareness of How to Access Promoted Energy Technologies
column6: % of respondents who know how to access the promoted [specify the climate-smart technology]
column7: % de répondants qui savent comment accéder à la [spécifiez la technologie climato-compatible] promue
column10: The indicator measures respondents' awareness of where they can purchase the promoted energy technology, such as solar lamps, domestic biodigesters, improved cooking stoves, or building insulations. The data can help you design the content of any marketing activities and evaluate their effectiveness.

column6: % of [specify the target group] who have the knowledge / skills required to practice the promoted environmental protection practices
column7: nombre / % de [préciser le groupe cible] qui ont les connaissances / compétences requises pour mettre en pratique les mesures de protection de l'environnement promues
column10: This indicator is relevant when people targeted by environmental mainstreaming measures (e.g. project staff, partners) need specific knowledge or skills to practice the promoted practices. It measures the extent to which they have such knowledge or skills. Examples include knowing how to effectively consider environmental impact in procurement, segregate waste, or reduce energy consumption.

column6: number or % of targeted [specify: households / businesses] that started using the promoted environmentally-friendly energy technologies
column7: nombre ou % de [spécifier: ménages/ entreprises] cibles ayant commencé à utiliser les technologies énergétiques écologiques
column10: The indicator measures the number (or proportion) of the target population that started using the promoted types of environmentally-friendly energy technologies as a result of the project’s support. This can include technologies that either serve as eco-friendly sources of energy (solar lamps or biodigesters) or those that reduce the consumption of environmentally unsustainable energy sources (such as fuel-efficient stoves or housing insulation).

column6: Food Insecurity Experience Scale
column7: Echelle de l’Expérience d’Insécurité Alimentaire
column10: This indicator is primarily used by FAO for measuring and comparing food insecurity across different countries. It is based on respondents’ experience of food insecurity. Its methodology is very similar to the earlier developed Household Food Insecurity Access Scale (HFIAS); however, compared to HFIAS, it uses a 12-month long recall period and does not measure the frequency of experienced food insecurity.

column6: By Programme closure date, the prevalence and duration of acute malnutrition among children from 6-59 months within the programme area has decreased.
column7: À la date de clôture du programme, la prévalence et la durée de la malnutrition aiguë chez les enfants de 6 à 59 mois dans la zone du programme ont diminué.
column10:
When it comes to malnutrition, a distinction can be made between acute and 
chronic malnutrition. As the prevalence of acute malnutrition says something 
about the food security in a programme area, this term is used in defining this 
indicator. The target group is chosen based on WFP data, which show that acute 
malnutrition among children 6-59 months old gives a good indication of the 
nutritional status of a country. Lactating women are added here as a target 
group, as their health is crucial for the well-being of the children.

column6: average Household Food Insecurity Access Scale Score
column7: score moyen de l’Accès déterminant l’Insécurité alimentaire des Ménages
column10: This indicator measures the severity of household food insecurity. It focuses on the “access” aspect of food insecurity (i.e. not on food utilization). It is based on respondents’ perceptions of their households’ food vulnerability and on their behavioural responses to food insecurity.

column6: median Household Hunger Score of the targeted households
column7: Indice Domestique de la Faim médian des ménages cibles
column10: The indicator measures the scale of households’ food deprivation. It is based on a (validated) idea that the experience of household food deprivation causes predictable reactions that can be captured through a survey and summarized on a scale. It focuses on the food quantity dimension of food access and does not measure dietary quality. It should be used only in areas with very high levels of food insecurity.

column6: % of women of reproductive age (15 - 49 years) who ate foods from ? 5 food groups the previous day or night
column7: % de femmes en âge de procréer (15 - 49 ans) ayant consommé des aliments appartenant à au moins 5 groupes d’aliments distincts le jour ou la nuit précédents
column10: MDD-W assesses the proportion of women 15-49 years of age who have consumed at least five out of the ten pre-defined food groups the previous day or night. It is an indicator of a diet's micronutrient adequacy, an important dimension of its quality.

column6: % of households in the highest Coping Strategy Index score category
column7: % de ménages dans la catégorie la plus élevée de l'Indice de Stratégie de Survie
column10: The Coping Strategy Index (CSI) is an indicator of a household’s food security assessing the extent to which households use harmful coping strategies when they do not have enough food or enough money to buy food. The result is reported by a numeric score.

column6: % of the target population with acceptable Food Consumption Score (FCS)
column7: % de la population cible ayant un Score de Consommation Alimentaire acceptable (SCA)
column10: The Food Consumption Score (FCS) is a more complex indicator of a household's food security status, as it considers not only dietary diversity and food frequency but also the relative nutritional importance of different food groups (on the other hand, its use of relatively long, 7 days recall period, might make the data less precise).

column6: the average number of different food groups consumed by the household the previous day or night
column7: le nombre moyen des différents groupes d'aliments consommés par le ménage le jour ou la nuit précédents
column10: The Household Dietary Diversity Score (HDDS) indicator assesses a household's economic access to food (i.e. its ability to produce, purchase or otherwise secure food for consumption by all household members). It does not provide data on the nutritional quality of a person's diet.

column6: At the end of the programme, the average food production at household level in the programme area, expressed in grain equivalents based on calorie content, has increased from x to y.
column7: À la fin du programme, la production alimentaire moyenne au niveau des ménages dans la région du programme, exprimée en équivalents céréales sur la base de la teneur en calories, est passée de x à y.
column10: To obtain a complete understanding of food security in a region, it is not sufficient to examine only food consumption. Information about the production side is necessary as well. Grain equivalents enable evaluators and researchers to capture production of the most important crops with one unit of measurement, thus making it easier to set targets and to compare.

column6: the average number of different food groups consumed by [specify the target group] the previous day and night
column7: le nombre moyen des différents groupes d'aliments consommés par [préciser le groupe cible] le jour et la nuit précédents
column10: The indicator assesses the number of (pre-determined) food groups which were eaten by a specific target group the previous day or night. IDDS is most commonly used for children 6-23 months of age and for children 24-59 months of age but it can also be used for adults. It is an indicator of a diet's micronutrient adequacy, an important dimension of its quality. It does not measure the intake of kilocalories.

column5: Months of Adequate Household Food Provisioning
column6: the average duration of a period in the past 12 months when the target households had enough food to meet their members' needs
column7: la durée moyenne d'une période au cours des 12 derniers mois pendant laquelle les ménages cibles avaient suffisamment de nourriture pour répondre aux besoins de leurs membres
column10: There is a strong link between seasonally reoccurring hunger and child malnutrition. Reducing the duration of the "hunger gap" is among the best ways for lowering the prevalence of food insecurity and acute malnutrition.

column6: average value of the Reduced Coping Strategies Index
column7: valeur moyenne de l’Indice de Stratégie de Survie
column10: The Reduced Coping Strategies Index (RCSI) is a proxy indicator of household food insecurity. It considers both the frequency and severity of five pre-selected coping strategies that the household used in the seven days prior to the survey. It is a simplified version of the full Coping Strategies Index indicator.

column6: % of the target population with acceptable Food Consumption Score (FCS)
column7: % de la population cible ayant un Score de Consommation Alimentaire acceptable (SCA)
column10: The Food Consumption Score (FCS) is a more complex indicator of a household's food security status, as it considers not only dietary diversity and food frequency but also the relative nutritional importance of different food groups (on the other hand, its use of relatively long, 7 days recall period, might make the data less precise).

column6: the average monetary value of the households' consumption during a 7 days recall period
column7: la valeur monétaire moyenne de la consommation des ménages pendant une période de rappel de 7 jours
column10: The indicator measures the average financial value of the goods and services the target households used over a 7 day recall period, including those that were produced by the household members (i.e. were not purchased). It is among the most preferred – and also most demanding – indicators of household living standards.

column6: % of households in the emergency / crisis / stress / none category of the Livelihood Coping Strategy Index
column7: % de ménages dans la catégorie Urgence, Crise, Stress, Nulle / minimale de l'Indice de Stratégie d'Adaptation des moyens de subsistance
column10: The Livelihood Coping Strategy Index measures strategies a household employs when it cannot meet basic needs due to inadequate income in times of stress; the Index indicates coping capacity.

column6: % of women of reproductive age aware of at least X out of X [specify numbers] promoted dietary practices
column7: % de femmes en âge de procréer connaissant au moins X des X pratiques alimentaires promues
column10: This is a composite indicator summarising how many promoted, diet-related practices the caregivers are aware of (see examples below). It is highly recommended that you rephrase the indicator and measure also husbands'/ mothers-in-law’s/ other influencers' awareness (see comments below).

column6: % of households which in the past 12 months grew at least X out of X [specify numbers] promoted nutrient-rich crops
column7: % de ménages ayant cultivé au cours des 12 derniers mois au moins X des X cultures riches en nutriments promues
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of households growing a minimum number of promoted, nutrient-rich crops. It is an important indicator of households’ access to nutrient-rich foods.

column6: number or % of businesses that employed new staff as a result of the project's support
column7: nombre ou % d'entreprises qui ont employé du nouveau personnel en raison de l’appui du projet
column10: The indicator assesses the number (or percentage) of businesses that started employing people at new positions as a result of the provided support.

column6: % of target households living below the poverty line (based on the PPI index)
column7: % de ménages cibles vivant en dessous du seuil de pauvreté (sur la base de l’index Progress out of Poverty-PPI)
column10: The Poverty Probability Index (PPI) is a poverty measurement tool that has been used by over 400 organizations and businesses. Based on the answers to 10 country-specific questions about a household’s characteristics and asset ownership, it calculates the likelihood that the household is living below the poverty line.

column6: number of VET institutions that have updated labour market information
column7: nombre d'établissements d'EFP qui ont mis à jour l'information sur le marché du travail
column10: This indicator measures the number of VET institutions with the access to updated labour market information that enables them to ensure the relevance of their vocational courses to the labour market’s needs.

column6: At the end of the programme period, the households in the programme area have increased their cash spending on basic services by y%
column7: À la fin de la période du programme, les ménages de la zone du programme ont augmenté leurs dépenses en espèces pour les services de base avec y%
column10: Basic services refer to the strategies that are being used for meeting basic needs in household food security and water supplies, sanitation, health care and education. Specifications on these concepts need to be filled out in local context.

column6: number or % of households that gained additional, environmentally and economically sustainable sources of income
column7: nombre ou % de ménages ayant obtenu des sources de revenus supplémentaires, écologiquement et économiquement durables
column10: Income diversification is among the main climate change adaptation measures, as it enables households to avoid the risks associated with relying only on one main source of income. At the same time, meaningful income diversification needs to be economically and environmentally sustainable. Therefore, this indicator measures the extent to which the targeted households managed to diversify their livelihoods by gaining an additional income source that is likely to be environmentally and economically sustainable.

column6: number of supported persons from vulnerable group(s) that gained and retained their new employment for at least [specify the number] months
column7: nombre de personnes soutenues provenant de groupe(s) vulnérable(s) qui ont acquis et conservé leur nouvel emploi pendant au moins [précisez le nombre] mois
column10: The indicator assesses the number of people from vulnerable groups that, thanks to the provided support, were newly employed (full-time or part-time) and retained their employment for a pre-defined minimum period of time. It can be used for any types of vulnerable groups, such as people with disabilities, migrants, minorities or economically vulnerable persons.

column6: number of full-time equivalent (FTE) jobs created
column7: nombre d'emplois en équivalents temps plein (ETP) créés
column10: The indicator measures the number of full-time equivalent (FTE) jobs that were created thanks to provided support. It aggregates part-time and full-time jobs.

column6: number of people with reduced vulnerability to extreme weather events
column7: nombre de personnes moins vulnérables aux événements météorologiques extrêmes
column10: This is a composite indicator measuring the number of people whose vulnerability to selected extreme weather events (e.g. floods, drought) has decreased as a result of the intervention. It indicates the scale of the provided support (and its benefits); however, it does not capture the extent to which has people’s vulnerability decreased.

column6: total value of promoted loans accessed by [specify the target groups] in the past [specify the period]
column7: valeur totale des prêts promus auxquels [spécifiez les groupes cibles] ont eu accès pendant [spécifiez la période] passé
column10: The indicator shows the amount of finance that was made available (as a loan) by the project partner(s), such as banks, micro-finance institutions, cooperatives, etc., to the targeted businesses.

column6: % of households with women actively engaged in household economic decisions
column7: % de ménages dans lesquels des femmes sont activement impliquées dans les décisions économiques du ménage
column10: This indicator measures the extent to which women can influence the economic decisions made within their household. This has a crucial impact on their demand for various products and services and is an important pre-condition for greater gender equality.

column6: the average monthly income of the target households in the past [specify the number] months
column7: le revenu mensuel moyen des ménages cibles au cours des [précisez le nombre] derniers mois
column10: The indicator assesses the average income the target households' members generated over a certain period of time. While the indicator is commonly used, it often provides unreliable data (see comments below). If possible, replace (or complement) it by using consumption and assets-based indicators.

column6: the average monetary value of the households' consumption during a 7 days recall period
column7: la valeur monétaire moyenne de la consommation des ménages pendant une période de rappel de 7 jours
column10: The indicator measures the average financial value of the goods and services the target households used over a 7 day recall period, including those that were produced by the household members (i.e. were not purchased). It is among the most preferred – and also most demanding – indicators of household living standards.

column6: the average households' expenditures during a [specify number] day recall period
column7: les dépenses moyennes des ménages pendant une période de rappel de [précisez le nombre] jours
column10: The indicator measures the average amount of money the target households spent in a given period on goods and services. It is commonly used as a proxy indicator for measuring income.

column6: average monthly income of the employees in the past [specify number] months
column7: le revenu mensuel moyen des employés au cours des [précisez le nombre] derniers mois
column10: The indicator assesses the average monthly income gained by either 1) the employees whom the project helped to gain employment; or 2) the employees of enterprises that received support to create these new employment positions.

column6: average monthly net income of supported businesses for the past [specify number] months
column7: revenu net mensuel moyen des entreprises appuyées pendant les [précisez le nombre] derniers mois
column10: The indicator assesses the average monthly net income of businesses supported by an intervention, an important aspect of the intervention's effectiveness.

column6: number or % of targeted [specify: households / businesses] that increased their income from [specify the activity] as a result of the provided assistance
column7: nombre ou % de [spécifier: ménages/ entreprises] ciblé(e)s ayant augmenté leur revenu tiré de [spécifier l’activité] grâce à l’assistance fournie
column10: The indicator assesses the number or proportion of target households (or businesses) which - thanks to the provided assistance - increased their income from a specific income-generating activity. This is a common indicator of income-generating interventions. It can be amended to measure whether the increase reached a pre-defined minimum level (for example, “at least by 20%”).

column6: average amount of savings among the target households
column7: montant moyen d'économies parmi les ménages cibles
column10: The indicator measures the average amount of savings the target households (or individuals) managed to accumulate. It is an important proxy indicator of households' economic situation.

column6: % of workers with formal contracts
column7: % de travailleurs avec un contrat formel
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of workers with a formal contract that specifies the conditions of their work, their rights and their responsibilities.  While having a contract does not automatically mean that a worker’s rights are protected, in many contexts it does offer a higher level of security than work based on a verbal agreement only.

column6: average amount of debts among the target beneficiaries
column7: montant moyen des dettes parmi les bénéficiaires cibles
column10: The indicator assesses the prevalence and levels of debts among the target population - an important proxy indicator of its economic status.

column6: number or % of employers who have adopted the promoted labour safety measures
column7: nombre ou % d'employeurs ayant adopté les mesures de sécurité au travail promues
column10: The indicator assesses the extent to which the targeted employers adopted at least a pre-set minimum of the promoted measures that contribute to the safety of their employees, such as requiring the employees to use protective clothing and equipment (and providing these), training employees on safety measures (e.g. first aid, equipment operation), keeping emergency kits accessible, ensuring adequate hygiene facilities or providing regular breaks.

column6: the average number of [specify the product] sold by the supported businesses in the past [specify the period]
column7: nombre moyen de [spécifiez le produit] vendus par les entreprises soutenues pendant [spécifiez la période] passée
column10: The indicator measures the amount of (promoted) products sold over a given period – an important indicator of the sellers' performance.

column6: % of training time spent in the workplace by trainees of [specify the VET program] in [specify the given period]
column7: % du temps de formation passé sur le lieu de travail par les étudiants en [spécifiez le programme d'EFP] pendant [spécifiez la période donnée]
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of training time that the trainees of a given vocational education and training (VET) program on average spend in the workplace out of the total training time.

column6: average savings of the saving groups members
column7: montant moyen d’économies réalisées par les membres de groupes d’épargne
column10: The indicator assesses the average amount saved by the saving group members at the time of the survey.

column5: Saving and Loan Groups – Total Value of Provided Loans
column6: total value of loans provided by the target saving and loan groups to their members in the past [specify the time period]
column7: valeur totale des prêts accordés par les groupes d’épargne et de crédit ciblés à leurs membres dans le/la/les dernier(e)(s) [spécifier l’intervalle de temps]
column10: The indicator measures the total amount of loans provided by the targeted saving and loan members in the given period. It is an important proxy indicator of the groups’ performance and their contribution to improving people’s access to income.

column6: number of proposals for improving the existing business environment that were officially put into practice by the relevant authorities
column7: nombre de propositions pour améliorer l’environnement commercial actuel qui ont été officiellement mises en œuvre par les autorités compétentes
column10: The indicator measures the number of proposals for improving the business environment that were proposed as part of a project, which the relevant authorities officially accepted, and subsequently put into practice. This can include, for example, making the business registration process faster / less expensive, improving infrastructure (e.g. roads), improving women’s access to finance, or adjusting taxation (e.g. lower VAT on green products).

column6: % of customers using [specify the promoted product / service] who would recommend its purchase to other people
column7: % de clients utilisant [spécifiez le produit / service promu] qui recommanderaient son achat à d'autres personnes
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of people using the promoted product / service who would recommend its purchase and use to other people – an important proxy for product / service quality, and customers’ appreciation of its benefits.

column6: % of the supported [specify the target group] meeting the pre-set preconditions for the sustainability of their operations
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] appuyés remplissant les conditions préalablement établies pour la durabilité de leurs opérations
column10: The indicator shows the extent to which the targeted service providers / sellers / other businesses meet the most crucial preconditions for the sustainability of their operations. It is useful, especially during mid-term reviews when there is still enough time to address the identified weaknesses.

column5: Investments into Promoted Business Practices / Models
column6: % of [specify the target group] who covered at least [specify the %] of the total costs of adopting the promoted business [select: practices / model]
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui ont couvert au moins [précisez le %] des coûts totaux d'adoption des [sélectionnez : pratiques / modèle] commerciales promues
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of the targeted businesses who covered at least a predefined minimum of the costs (e.g. 60%) of adopting the promoted business practices / overall business model. It indicates the extent to which they perceived that the practices are worth the investment. It is important to measure as contributions can demonstrate the value, commitment and ownership the business has attached to what the project has promoted.

column5: Marketing Practices Leading to Higher Sales
column6: % of [specify: farmers / shop keepers / service providers / ... ] reporting higher sales as a result of using the promoted marketing practices
column7: % de [spécifiez: agriculteurs / commerçants / prestataires de services / ... ] qui déclarent des ventes plus élevées grâce à l'utilisation des pratiques commerciales promues
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of businesses that report achieving higher sales as a result of using the marketing practices promoted by the intervention. It shows the perceived effectiveness of using the promoted marketing practices.

column6: number or % of [specify the target group] that achieve at least a [specify the %] return on investment within [specify the period] of making the investment
column7: nombre ou % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui réalisent au moins [spécifiez le %] de retour sur investissement [préciser la période] après l'investissement
column10: This indicator looks at the proportion of supported businesses which managed to achieve a specific return on investment (ROI). This measure is used to see how cost-effective the set of project-related investments was. Be aware that in order to gain reliable data on ROI you need to accurately assess the net profit, which is not easy. The “% ROI” is used since development projects often do not last long enough to be able to see a full ROI.

column6: average [select: monthly / annual] sales revenue of [specify the target group]
column7: moyenne du chiffre d’affaires [sélectionnez: mensuel / annuel] de [spécifiez le groupe cible]
column10: This indicator measures the sales that an individual or company receives from its business activities, usually the sale of goods or services. It is the amount of money received in a stated period of time, often known as Gross Income. Given the quality issues with measuring net income, sales revenue is often seen as the best proxy for measuring net income / profit.

column6: % of management positions in the [specify the employers or sub-sector] held by women
column7: % de postes de direction occupés par des femmes dans [spécifiez l'employeur ou le sous-secteur]
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the management positions of certain employers or in a certain sub-sector in a given geographical area are held by women. It can provide insights into women’s power in decision-making and the economy.

column5: Awareness of How to Access a Service
column6: % of target group members aware of how they can access [specify the provided service]
column7: % des membres du groupe cible qui savent comment accéder à [spécifier le service fourni]
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of the target group members who are aware of a given service and how can they access it. This could be counselling, training, or any other service provided by your organization as well as by government agencies, NGOs, or businesses. The data helps you understand any needs for further promotion of the service.

column5: Awareness of Where to Access Service
column6: % of respondents who know where to access [specify the promoted service]
column7: % de répondants qui savent où accéder à [spécifiez le service]
column10: The indicator measures respondents' awareness of where they can access (for free or paid) a service that is crucial for their lives and livelihoods, such as veterinary services, repairs of water pumps or specific advice. It helps you understand the effectiveness and reach of any promotional activities or initiatives to strengthen the marketing competencies of supported service providers.

column5: Awareness of Where to Purchase Product
column6: % of respondents who know where to locally purchase [specify the promoted product]
column7: % de répondants qui savent où acheter localement [spécifiez le produit promu]
column10: The indicator measures respondents' awareness of where they can purchase those goods that are crucial for their lives and livelihoods, such as seeds, veterinary medicine, solar panels or oral rehydration salts. It helps you understand the effectiveness and reach of any promotional activities or initiatives to strengthen the marketing competencies of supported sellers.

column6: number / % of the local markets where [specify the product / service] is readily available
column7: nombre / % des marchés locaux où [spécifiez le produit / service] est disponible
column10: Whereas other indicators measure the number of actors offering a given product / service, this indicator focuses on the extent to which a product / service is available in the various geographical areas targeted by an intervention. For example, it can show you the areas where it is difficult or impossible for people to purchase the product / service. It is a crucial precondition for people being able to use the desired products or services.

column6: number of service providers offering [specify the service] in the target area
column7: nombre de prestataires de services offrant [spécifiez le service] dans la zone cible
column10: This is an essential 'supply side' indicator assessing the number of service providers (such as repairers, commercial extension workers, companies offering house insulation, etc.) offering the promoted type of service(s) in a target area. It shows the extent to which the service is physically available to the potential customers.

column6: % of [specify the sellers] with the minimum amount of targeted products readily available for sale
column7: % de [spécifiez les vendeurs] ayant la quantité minimum de produits cibles disponibles à la vente
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of sellers with a minimum amount of the targeted products available for sale. It is more useful than measuring the total number of products in stock, as it indicates the products’ geographical availability. The sellers’ ability to sell the products at a time when the customers need them is among the main preconditions for ensuring adequate supply. It can also contribute to an increased usage of the products.

column6: average number of predefined types of [specify the products] sold by the target sellers
column7: nombre moyen de types prédéfinis de [spécifiez les produits] vendus par les vendeurs ciblés
column10: The indicator assesses the average number of pre-defined types of products (such as different agricultural inputs) sold by the target sellers. It is used in interventions aiming to increase the diversity of the products sold by the targeted sellers.

column6: the average number of clients of the targeted sellers / service providers in the past [specify the period]
column7: nombre moyen de clients des vendeurs / prestataires de service ciblés pendant [spécifiez la période] passé
column10: The indicator is used to measure the average number of people purchasing or receiving goods / services from the supported sellers / service providers. It is an important aspect of their performance and suggests the extent to which they benefit the target population. Its limitation is that it does not consider the ‘weight’ of the service – e.g., how many times it was used, how much money was spent, what the extent of the service was, etc.

column6: number of selling points offering [specify the product] in the target area
column7: nombre de points de vente proposant [spécifiez le produit] dans la zone cible
column10: This is an essential 'supply side' indicator assessing the number of sellers (physical or online shops, market stalls, mobile sellers) in a target area offering the promoted product (for example, a certain type of fuel-efficient stove). It shows the extent to which the product is physically available to the potential customers.

column6: % of service providers whose services meet at least [specify the percentage] of the predefined Quality Standards
column7: % de prestataires de service dont les prestations répondent à au moins [spécifiez le pourcentage] des normes de qualité prédéfinies
column10: The indicator is used for assessing pre-selected aspects of the quality of the supported services.

column6: number or % of target farmers who in the past [specify number] months started selling their produce to new markets
column7: nombre ou % d'agriculteurs ciblés qui, dans les [précisez nombre] mois précédents, ont commencé à vendre leurs produits à de nouveaux marchés
column10: Farmers’ ability to sell to new markets is likely to reduce their dependency on the price offered by monopolistic buyers, increasing their chances of receiving a higher income for their produce. This indicator therefore measures the number and proportion of target farmers who started selling their produce to new, previously unutilized markets (i.e. buyers).
