column6: number / % of [specify the target groups] who in the past [specify the period] used one or more of the promoted financial products / services
column7: nombre / % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] qui par le passé [spécifiez la période] ont utilisé un ou plusieurs des produits / services financiers promus
column10: This indicator measures the number (or percentage) of the target individuals or companies that applied for and used one or more of the promoted financial products / services, such as loans, lease-to-own payments, insurance products, money transfers, or saving accounts.

column6: % of households who in the past [specify number] months used the promoted [specify the product / service]
column7: % de ménages qui, au cours des [spécifiez le nombre] derniers mois ont utilisé [spécifiez le produit / service] promu
column10: The commercial as well as public sector offer thousands of products and services that considerably improve people's lives and livelihoods, such as water filters, agricultural inputs or different types of advisory services. This is an important coverage indicator measuring the proportion of the target households that in a certain period used the promoted product / service. It shows the met demand for the promoted product / service.

column6: average amount spent by the project on creating one job
column7: montant moyen dépensé par le projet pour la création d'un emploi
column10: The indicator measures the average costs of creating a job. It shows the cost-effectiveness of the provided support and helps with calculating its value for money (especially when the costs of the support per each job are considered against the financial and non-financial benefits the job provides to the employee / entrepreneur).

column5: Completion Rate in Vocational Education Training
column6: % of trainees who completed [specify the VET program]
column7: % d’étudiants ayant achevé [précisez le programme d'EFP]
column10: The indicator assesses the percentage of participants who were enrolled in a given vocational education training (VET) program at a given time period and successfully completed their vocational training.

column5: Dropout Rate in Vocational Education Training
column6: % of trainees who enrolled but did not complete [specify the VET program]
column7: % d’étudiants inscrits mais qui n’ont pas achevé [précisez le programme d’EFP]
column10: The indicator assesses the percentage of participants who were enrolled in a given vocational education training (VET) program at a given time period and did not complete the training.

column6: number of supported persons from vulnerable group(s) that gained and retained their new employment for at least [specify the number] months
column7: nombre de personnes soutenues provenant de groupe(s) vulnérable(s) qui ont acquis et conservé leur nouvel emploi pendant au moins [précisez le nombre] mois
column10: The indicator assesses the number of people from vulnerable groups that, thanks to the provided support, were newly employed (full-time or part-time) and retained their employment for a pre-defined minimum period of time. It can be used for any types of vulnerable groups, such as people with disabilities, migrants, minorities or economically vulnerable persons.

column6: number or % of [select: new / improved / existing] VET programs that are relevant to the job market’s needs
column7: nombre ou % de programmes d’EFP [sélectionnez: nouveaux / améliorés / existants] qui répondent aux besoins du marché du travail
column10: Vocational education is supposed to serve the youth and adults to gain more productive opportunities through increased marketable skills. This indicator assesses the number or the proportion of existing and newly developed vocational education and training (VET) programs that reflect the current local labour market’s needs (i.e. their design is in line with the occupational profiles demanded by the market).

column6: % of trainees from vulnerable groups who enrolled/ completed the VET program (out of the total number of participants/ completers)
column7: % d’étudiants issus de groupes vulnérables étant inscrits/  ayant achevé le programme d’EFP (sur le nombre total de participants/ personnes ayant terminé)
column10: The indicator assesses the participation/ success rate of vocational training students from vulnerable group(s), such as certain ethnic minorities, people with disabilities or unemployed youth.

column6: number of VET providers with established internship scheme for their students
column7: nombre de prestataires d'EFP avec un programme établi de stage pour leurs étudiants
column10: This indicator assesses the number of VET providers offering internships for their students. Work-based learning such as internships enable the students to apply and expand the skills they learnt; assess their own interests and abilities; learn about future employers’ expectations; establish useful contacts and gain other practical competencies.

column5: Achievement of Vocational Education Training Competency Standards
column6: number or % of VET trainees who have met VET competency standards in the given trade and VET institution
column7: nombre ou % d’étudiants en EFP qui ont satisfait aux normes de compétence d’EFP dans le métier en question et dans les établissements d’EFP
column10: The indicator assesses the number or proportion of vocational education training (VET) participants who gained the knowledge and skills required for a certain occupation as defined by locally recognized (national, if they exist) competency standards. The standards are used as the basis for defining learning outcomes and assessment benchmarks within the VET sector. It is an important indicator of VET program’s effectiveness.

column5: Employers’ Use of Job Matching Services
column6: number of targeted employers that used at least one of the promoted job-matching services in the past [specify number] months
column7: nombre d'employeurs ciblés qui ont eu recours à au moins une des agences de placement d’emplois promues au cours des [spécifiez le nombre] derniers mois
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the targeted employers have used the promoted job-matching services, such as dedicated websites with job advertisements, print-media advertising, career counseling, job fairs or the services of recruitment agencies. It shows the effectiveness of activities that promote employers’ use of job-matching services.

column5: Employment of Vocational Education Training Completers
column6: number or % of VET completers working in relevant occupations [employed / self-employed / both] one month / 6 months after the end of the training
column7: ayant terminé l’EFP travaillant dans les professions correspondantes en tant que [travailleur salarié / indépendant / les deux] un mois/ 6 mois après la fin de la formation?
column10: The indicator assesses the extent to which vocational education training (VET) program graduates are able to gain and retain a job in the profession they were trained in (being either employed or self-employed). It is an essential sign of the VET program’s effectiveness.

column6: number or % of participants who have gained the required knowledge and skills in the supported life skills-based education programs
column7: nombre ou % de participants ayant acquis les connaissances et compétences requises dans les programmes d'éducation sur les compétences essentielles (life skills)  qui sont appuyés
column10: Life skills-based education programs focus on the development of knowledge, attitudes, values and skills, which enable people to deal effectively with the demands and challenges of life. The indicator measures the number or proportion of learners that have achieved the pre-defined minimum learning outcomes in a given life skills-based education program. It demonstrates the ultimate effect of any life skills development intervention.

column5: Job Seekers’ Awareness of Job Matching Services
column6: % of [specify the target group] able to recall at least one of the promoted job-matching services
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] capable de se souvenir d'au moins une des agences de placement d'emplois promues
column10: The indicator assesses the extent to which the target group members (e.g. youth) are able to recall at least one of the promoted job-matching services. It shows the effectiveness of any promotion campaigns recommending job seekers to use the promoted services.

column6: number or % of VET teachers/ trainers who successfully completed training in given field
column7: nombre or % d'enseignants/ formateurs d’EFP ayant réussi une formation dans un domaine donné
column10: Training for teachers and trainers can have a great impact on student learning outcomes. This indicator measures the number or percentage of teachers/trainers who completed a training course on given topic and successfully met the performance based training requirements.

column6: number of target communities which completed the Vulnerability and Capacity Assessment and designed a follow-up action plan
column7: nombre de communautés cibles qui ont accompli l'Evaluation de la Vulnérabilité et de la Capacité et conçu un plan d'action de suivi
column10: The indicator measures the number of the target communities whose members completed the Vulnerability and Capacity Assessment, agreed on the follow-up actions and documented them.

column6: % of [specify the target group] with the desired knowledge / skills of [specify the topic]
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] avec les connaissances / compétences souhaitées de [préciser le sujet]
column10: The indicator measures the learning benefits of any knowledge and skills-transfer activities, such as training or workshops. Not only can it be used for a single activity (e.g. training), but also for the sum of different knowledge and skills-transfer activities.

column6: number or % of VET institutions with adequate facilities for practical training
column7: nombre ou % d’établissements d’EFP disposant d’installations adéquates pour la formation pratique
column10: The indicator assesses the number or proportion of vocational education training (VET) providers with the facilities required for allowing their students to sufficiently practice and learn the taught skills – an essential component of any vocational education.

column6: number of students newly enrolled in VET training in [specify the time period]
column7: nombre d’étudiants nouvellement inscrits dans une formation d’EFP pendant [précisez la période]
column10: The indicator assesses the number of students who started attending vocational education training (VET) at a given time period.

column5: Job Seekers’ Use of Job Matching Services
column6: % of [specify the target group] who in the past 12 months looked for a job and used one of the promoted job-matching services
column7: % de [précisez le groupe cible] qui, au cours des 12 derniers mois, ont cherché un emploi et utilisé une des agences de placement d'emplois promues
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of the target group members (e.g. youth, women, internally displaced persons) who have used the job-matching services promoted as a part of the intervention. It indicates the extent to which they know of the services and are willing to use them to help them find suitable employment opportunities.

column6: average number of VET trainees per trainer [if required, specify: given trade, VET institution, school year]
column7: nombre moyen d’étudiants en EFP par formateur [si nécessaire, précisez: métier, établissement d'EFP, année scolaire]
column10: Trainee to Trainer ratio belongs among the key factors influencing the quality of the students' learning. A high trainee-trainer ratio suggests that each trainer is responsible for a large number of pupils. The lower the number of trainees in the group, the higher the relative access of trainees to the trainer and the available equipment. Trainers can also pay attention to the individual trainees, which may positively impact on their performance.

column6: number or % of supported VET institutions meeting locally agreed VET Quality Standards
column7: nombre ou % d'établissements d’EFP appuyées respectant les Normes de Qualité d’EFP agréées au niveau local
column10: The indicator assesses to what extent the VET services that your organisation supports meet pre-defined Quality Standards and are therefore likely to benefit the participating students.

column3: Community based conflict prevention and resolution
column5: Conflicts Addressed and Resolved by Different Actors
column6: Number, % and type of conflicts that are addressed and resolved by community structures (e.g. peace committees) and formal justice and security actors
column7: Nombre, % et type de conflits abordés et résolus par les structures communautaires (par exemple les comités de paix) et les acteurs formels de la justice et de la sécurité
column10: This indicator aims to measure the work of the peace committees or formal justice providers (e.g. formal courts).  How relevant and effective are these actors in conflict resolution, and for which type of conflicts?

column3: Community based conflict prevention and resolution
column6: % of population in project area that trust the peace committee (or police, court)
column7: % de la population qui fait confiance dans le comité de paix (ou la police, la justice)
column10: This indicator aims to measure the trust of the population in these formal/informal institutions.

column3: Community based conflict prevention and resolution
column6: Percentage of (former) parties in conflict declaring that they are satisfied with the resolution process, disaggregated by type of conflict resolution mechanism and type of conflict
column7: Pourcentage des (anciennes) parties au conflit se déclarant satisfaites du processus de résolution, ventilé par type de mécanisme de résolution des conflits et par type de conflit
column10: Having a more qualitative measurement of the way the conflict resolution mechanisms are appreciated by persons having their conflict mediated by these structures (e.g. peace committees, elders, faith leaders, formal justice providers etc)

column6: % of [choose: men / women] who say that wife beating is acceptable
column7: % de [choisir: hommes / femmes] qui affirment que battre les femmes est acceptable
column10: This indicator measures the proportion of either men or women who consider wife beating as an acceptable way of treating wives.

column5: Awareness of Available Support for GBV survivors
column6: % of women aware of where women affected by GBV can access the required support
column7: % de femmes qui savent à quel endroit les femmes victimes de violence basée sur le genre peuvent obtenir le soutien nécessaire
column10: The available data show that a large proportion of women living in low-income countries have at some point in their life experienced gender based violence. Awareness of available support is an important pre-condition for women accessing the assistance they need. Therefore, this indicator measures the proportion of women that are aware of where women affected by gender based violence can access the required support

column6: % of women aged 15 - 49 who experienced severe physical violence in the past 12 months
column7: % de femmes âgées de 15 à 49 ans ayant subi des violences physiques graves au cours des 12 derniers mois
column10: Freedom from violence is a critical aspect of women’s empowerment and greater gender equality. This indicator therefore measures the proportion of women who in the past 12 months experienced severe physical violence. Considering how sensitive (and in some ways also demanding) the collection of the required data is, it should be used only in interventions that are specifically addressing the prevention and response to gender-based violence.

column6: % of women aged 15 - 49 who experienced sexual violence in the past 12 months
column7: % de femmes âgées de 15 à 49 ans victimes de violence sexuelle au cours des 12 derniers mois
column10: Freedom from violence is a critical aspect of women’s empowerment and greater gender equality. This indicator therefore measures the proportion of women who in the past 12 months experienced sexual violence. Considering how sensitive the collection of the data required for this indicator is, this indicator should be used only in interventions that are specifically addressing the prevention and response to sexual violence.

column5: Land Tenure Security (Legal Documentation and Perception)
column6: Proportion of total adult population with secure tenure rights to land, with (a) legally recognized documentation; and (b) who perceive their rights to land as secure, by sex and by type of tenure.
column7: Proportion de la population adulte totale ayant des droits fonciers sécurisé, avec (a) des documents légalement reconnus ; et (b) qui perçoivent leurs droits fonciers comme sécurisé, par sexe et type de régime.
column10: Determining land tenure security by measuring both the recognized legal documentation of land tenure rights, and people's perception of how secure their land tenure rights are (whether they are legally documented or not).

column5: Level of Equal Rights to Land for Women and Men
column6: Level to which women and men have equal rights to land, including rights to use, control, own, inherit and transact these rights.
column7: Degré d'égalité des droits des femmes et des hommes à la terre, y compris les droits d'utilisation, de contrôle, de propriété, d'héritage et de transaction.
column10: Meauring gender (in)equality when it comes to rights to land. In many of the contexts ZOA works in, we see that women have weaker land tenure security than men, while there are many benefits for all if this rights to land are (more) equal for women and men. This indicators measures progress towards that objective.

column6: Percentage of land administration service users rating the satisfaction of provided services on a scale from 1 to 5.
column7: Pourcentage d'utilisateurs des services d'administration foncière évaluant la satisfaction des services fournis sur une échelle de 1 à 5.
column10: Measuring the satisfaction rate of the population that should be serviced by the land administration services as a way to measure the performance of these services.

column6: Percentage of population who have been involved in land disputes in the past X years.
column7: Pourcentage de la population ayant été impliquée dans des litiges fonciers au cours des X dernières années.
column10: Measuring the prevalence of land disputes before an intervention will show the scale and severity of land disputes. Measuring the prevalence of land disputes during the intervention will show how the intervention is affecting this prevalence compared to the initial measurement. Measuring the prevalence of land disputes after the intervention will show the effect of the intervention on the prevalence of land disputes and how this has changed over the course of the intervention period.

column5: Land Conflict Resolution Rate through ADR
column6: Percentage of land conflicts addressed to local alternative dispute resolution (ADR) structure that has been resolved, disaggregated by sex and type of land conflict
column7: Pourcentage de conflits fonciers adressés à une structure locale de résolution alternative des conflits (ADR) qui ont été résolus, ventilé par sexe et par type de conflit foncier.
column10: Measuring the land conflict resolution rate of alternative dispute resolution structures by comparing the total number of land conflicts addressed to the ADR structure with the number of those conflict that have been resolved by the ADR structure. Disaggregating the data by type of land conflict will give insight in whether there are certain types of land conflicts that have a low or high resolution rate through ADR.

column5: Number of Land Certificates or Title Deeds Issued
column6: # land certificates or title deeds issued through the support of the intervention, disaggregated by sex
column7: # certificats fonciers ou titres de propriété délivrés grâce au soutien de l'intervention, ventilés par sexe
column10: Measuring how many land certificates of title deeds were issued with the support of the intervention.

column5: Women's Land Rights on Issued Land Certificates or Title Deeds
column6: Percentage of land certificates or title deeds issued through the support of the intervention that mention women's land rights
column7: Pourcentage de certificats fonciers ou de titres de propriété délivrés grâce au soutien de l'intervention qui mentionnent les droits fonciers des femmes
column10: Measuring the level of protection of women's rights to land through the process of formalization of land rights.

column6: Proportion of the population who have experienced a dispute in the past two years and who accessed a formal or informal dispute resolution mechanism, by type of mechanism.
column7: Proportion de la population ayant connu un litige au cours des deux dernières années et ayant eu recours à un mécanisme formel ou informel de résolution des litiges, par type de mécanisme.
column10: To measure equal access to justice for all.

column6: Number and % of population (disaggregated by gender) who feel secure in the area where they live compared to last year
column7: Nombre et % de la population (ventilée par sexe) qui se sent en sécurité dans la zone où elle vit par rapport à l'année dernière
column10: The indicator aims to measure how people perceive security, which might be different from objective security data (e.g. number of violent deaths).

column6: % of population in the intervention area who observe a decrease in violent conflicts within their community
column7: % de la population dans la zone d'intervention qui observe une réduction des conflits violents au sein de leur communauté
column10: This indicator aims to measure the perception of the population in the targeted area who perceive a reduction in violence.

column6: xx
column7: xx
column10: xx

column6: % of the population that perceive an improvement in community cohesion
column7: % de la population qui perçoit une amélioration de la cohésion communautaire
column10: This indicator aims to assess and measure community cohesion within the specific cultural context of Iraq. It is a combination of a standarised tool to measure community (or social) cohesion (Perceived Neighbourhood Social Cohesion Questionnaire) and bottom up indicators.

column5: Perception of Social Cohesion and Trust
column6: % of population that perceive an improvement in social cohesion and trust across conflict lines or groups with diverse (ethnic/religious/political) background
column7: % de la population qui perçoit une amélioration de la cohésion sociale et de la confiance au-delà des lignes de conflit ou des groupes d'origines (ethniques/religieuses/politiques) diverses
column10: This indicator aims to measure people's perception of social cohesion and trust, which are often seriously damaged after conflict.

column6: % of participants that show an improvement in their sense of community
column7: % de participants ayant constaté une amélioration de leur sentiment d'appartenance à la communauté
column10: The Sense of Community index (SCI) is the most frequently used quantitative measure of sense of community in different contexts across the world. It focuses on four elements, including membership, influence, meeting needs and shared emotional connection.

column6: Percentage of people in the project area who profess trust in those from other faith or ethnic groups
column7: Pourcentage de personnes dans la zone du projet qui font confiance aux personnes d'autres confessions ou groupes ethniques
column10: To assess the level of trust between groups that are generally suspicous or fearful of each other or that have a history of conflict between each other as a way of assessing whether divisons are increasing or decreasing.

column6: % of project participants that experience an improvement in their mental wellbeing
column7: % des participants au projet ayant constaté une amélioration de leur bien-être mental
column10: The indicator aims to evaluate the mental wellbeing of a person, based on a self reporting questionnaire.

column6: % of target population living in safe and dignified shelters in secure settlements
column7: % de la population cible vivant dans des abris sûrs et dignes dans des sites sécurisés
column10: This composite indicator was designed by ECHO as one of its Key Outcome Indicators. It is based on two main sub-indicators.

column6: Percentage of households that report pressure to leave their shelter for financial reasons
column7:
Pourcentage de ménages déclarant avoir été contraints de quitter leur logement pour
des raisons financières
column10: To measure outcomes of CVA assistance in terms of shelter.

column6: Percentage of households that report having minimum household items that allow all the following: comfortable sleeping, water and food storage, food preparation, cooking, eating, lighting, and clothing
column7:
Pourcentage de ménages déclarant avoir un accès minimum à des articles domestiques
non alimentaires permettant la totalité de ce qui suit : dormir confortablement, stocker l’eau et la nourriture, préparer la no
column10: To measure sector-specific outcomes of CVA assistance related to NFI.

column6: Percentage of households that report living in a shelter that has all the following: adequate space, feels safe, feels private and protected from the weather.
column7: Pourcentage de ménages déclarant vivre dans un abri présentant toutes les caractéristiques suivantes : espace adéquat (dignité), sentiment de sécurité physique, intimité et protection contre les intempéries.
column10: To measure sector-specific outcomes of CVA assistance related to shelter.

column6: Percentage of households that report that their shelter feels warm enough at night
column7: Pourcentage de ménages déclarant que leurs abris sont suffisamment chauds la nuit
column10: To measure sector-specific outcomes of CVA assistance related to shelter.

column5: Use of Cash/ Materials for Shelter (Re)Construction
column6: number of assisted households which effectively used the provided cash/ materials for shelter (re)construction
column7: nombre de ménages assistés qui ont utilisé efficacement l’argent / les matériaux fournis pour la (re)construction d’abris
column10: The indicator measures the number of households which effectively used the provided cash/ materials for the intended purpose - shelter (re)construction.

column6: number of people having access to basic, safe and dignified shelters solutions
column7: nombre de personnes ayant accès à des solutions d'abris de base, sûres et dignes
column10: This ECHO's Key Result Indicator assesses the number of target beneficiaries having access to shelter solutions whose size meets Sphere Standards, the design of which is culturally acceptable, and (re)construction of which is in accordance with safe building practices and involves the affected population.

column6: number or % of targeted population receiving NFI kits
column7: nombre ou % de la population cible recevant des kits de produits non alimentaires
column10: The indicator measures the number of people receiving kits with non-food items. It should always be complemented with an indicator assessing beneficiaries' satisfaction with the provided support.

column6: number of individuals with safe and equal access to newly protected [specify the public infrastructure/ service]
column7: nombre d'individus ayant un accès sûr et égal à la [précisez l'infrastructure/ service public] nouvellement protégé
column10: This indicator measures the number of people who have continued access to critical public infrastructure/ services protected from the impacts of major identified hazards. Key public infrastructure/ services may include health centers, schools, water sources, roads, etc.

column6: number or % of target households living in adequate shelters meeting shelter standards as defined by the National Shelter Cluster
column7: nombre ou % de ménages cibles vivant dans des abris adéquats conformes aux standards en matière d’abri définis par le Cluster National Abri
column10: The indicator assesses the number (or proportion) of target households living in shelters that meet the standards set by the National Shelter Cluster.

column6: number of schools improved to meet Infrastructure Quality Standards for schools
column7: nombre ou % d'écoles dont les bâtiments répondent aux Normes de Qualité des Infrastructures pour les écoles
column10: School infrastructure plays a significant role among the factors influencing student learning, physical and emotional well-being and safety. The indicator assesses the status of the educational infrastructure and physical learning environment in supported schools.

column6: number of communities with functional disaster risk management mechanism
column7: nombre de communautés ayant un mécanisme fonctionnel de gestion des risques de catastrophe
column10: This indicator assesses the number of communities with a functional system for managing the risk of disaster.

column6: number of communities which completed at least [specify the percentage] of their disaster preparedness plan's action points
column7: nombre de communautés qui ont accompli au moins [précisez le %] des points d’actions de leurs plans de préparation aux catastrophe
column10: The indicator measures the number of the target communities who completed a minimum percentage of the action points set in their disaster preparedness plans.

column6: the key protection risks related to the project activities were assessed and relevant risk mitigation measures were implemented
column7: les principaux risques de protection liés aux activités du projet ont été évalués et des mesures pertinentes d'atténuation des risques ont été mises en œuvre
column10: The fulfilment of this indicator means that a project competently assessed the key protection risks connected to the project activities and then designed and effectively implemented relevant measures that minimize the risks.

column5: Protection of Services / Infrastructure Against Hazards
column6: number of essential service providers and infrastructure with an improved protection against the most likely hazards
column7: nombre de fournisseurs de services essentiels et d'infrastructures disposant d’une protection améliorée contre les risques les plus probables
column10: The indicator measures the number of essential service providers & infrastructure types people rely on (such as health centres, schools, roads, bridges) that were protected by the project’s activities against the most likely hazards, such as floods or landslides.

column6: number or % of (re)constructed shelters incorporating hazard mitigation measures
column7: nombre ou % d’abris (re)construits incorporant des mesures visant à réduire les risques
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the supported shelter solutions incorporate specific measures designed to mitigate the impact of hazards experienced in the area of intervention, such as storms or earthquakes.

column6: % of [specify the target group] who follow the promoted fuel-efficient cooking practices
column7: % de [préciser le groupe cible] qui suivent les pratiques promues pour une cuisine économe en combustible
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the target group members follow the promoted ways of reducing the volume of cooking fuel (e.g. charcoal, wood, gas, etc.).

column6: increased use of environmentally friendly construction materials and methods
column7: utilisation accrue de matériaux et de méthodes de construction respectueux de l'environnement
column10: This qualitative indicator indicates that the project used more environmentally-friendly construction materials and methods compared to standard (re)construction practices in the given area and context. It is intended for humanitarian contexts where exact quantifications of the environmental benefits might not be feasible.

column6: % of beneficiaries reporting to be satisfied with the provided assistance
column7: % des bénéficiaires déclarant être satisfaits de l'assistance fournie
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of beneficiaries who were satisfied with the provided assistance, especially its usefulness.

column6: number of people with reduced vulnerability to extreme weather events
column7: nombre de personnes moins vulnérables aux événements météorologiques extrêmes
column10: This is a composite indicator measuring the number of people whose vulnerability to selected extreme weather events (e.g. floods, drought) has decreased as a result of the intervention. It indicates the scale of the provided support (and its benefits); however, it does not capture the extent to which has people’s vulnerability decreased.

column6: number of local people involved in voluntary or paid work on shelter (re)construction
column7: nombre de personnes locales impliquées dans un travail bénévole ou rémunéré pour la (re)construction d'abris
column10: The indicator assesses the number of people from the affected communities who were engaged by the assisting agency in the physical work required for (re)constructing shelters, both on a paid or voluntary basis.

column6: number or % of households whose dwellings incorporate the promoted hazard-resistant measures
column7: nombre ou % de ménages dont les habitations intègrent les caractéristiques de résistance aux risques promues
column10: The indicator measures the extent to which the target households applied the recommended measures for making their dwelling less vulnerable to the identified hazards (such as structural improvements in its construction or changes in the dwelling's surrounding environment).

column6: % of [specify the target group] with the desired knowledge / skills of [specify the topic]
column7: % de [spécifiez le groupe cible] avec les connaissances / compétences souhaitées de [préciser le sujet]
column10: The indicator measures the learning benefits of any knowledge and skills-transfer activities, such as training or workshops. Not only can it be used for a single activity (e.g. training), but also for the sum of different knowledge and skills-transfer activities.

column6: Percent of recipients (disaggregated by sex, age, and disability) reporting that humanitarian assistance is delivered in a safe, accessible, accountable, and participatory manner
column7: Pourcentage de bénéficiaires (ventilé par sexe, âge et handicap) ayant déclaré que l’aide humanitaire est fournie de manière sécuritaire, accessible, responsable et participative
column10:
It is recommended to include a Protection Mainstreaming process indicator in all actions providing MPC to affected populations. The purpose of this indicator is to facilitate the operationalisation of all four elements of protection mainstreaming and provide a way to measure the identification, implementation and monitoring of required corrective actions/measures. The overall goal is to have a positive impact on how the assistance is
delivered during the action.

column6: % beneficiaries considering that their basic WASH needs are met
column7: % de bénéficiaires considérant que leurs besoins de base en matière d’EHA sont satisfaits
column10: This sub-indicator was designed by ECHO as a part of its Key Outcome Indicators (KOI). It measures the proportion of the target population who perceive that their most essential WASH needs were met.

column6: % of children aged 8 - 23 / 59 months which in the past two weeks had at least 3 loose or liquid stools in one day
column7: % d'enfants âgés de 8-23 / 59 mois qui au cours des deux dernières semaines ont eu 3 ou plus de selles molles en un jour
column10: The indicator assesses the percentage of children who suffered from diarrhoea in the past two weeks (one of the leading causes of child death). Diarrhoea is defined as having 3 or more loose or liquid stools in one day.

column5: Awareness of the Causes and Prevention of Diarrhoea
column6: % of respondents who know at least three of the main causes of diarrhoea and three ways to prevent diarrhoea
column7: % de répondants capables d'indiquer trois des causes principales de la diarrhée et trois manières d’éviter la diarrhée
column10: The indicator assesses the extent to which the target population is aware of at least three causes of diarrhoea and three ways to prevent diarrhoea. It is commonly used for measuring the immediate results of hygiene promotion activities.

column6: % of caregivers who safely dispose of their children's faeces
column7: % de gardiens d’enfants qui s’occupent en toute sécurité des fèces de leurs enfants
column10: Even in households with access to latrines, children's faeces are often not disposed of safely and threaten both children's and adults' health. This indicator therefore assesses the proportion of caregivers who dispose of the children's faeces into improved sanitation facility.

column6: % of respondents who washed their hands with soap or ash in at least 3 out of 5 critical occasions in the past 2 days
column7: % des répondants qui déclarent s’être lavé les mains avec du savon ou de la cendre au moins 3 fois sur 5 moments clés au cours des deux derniers jours
column10: Washing hands with soap is the most effective way for preventing life-threatening diarrhoeal diseases. This indicator therefore measures whether people (report to) wash their hands with soap or ash in at least 3 out of 5 most important moments.

column6: % of households using basic sanitation services
column7: % de ménages utilisant une installation d'assainissement améliorée
column10: This indicator assesses the proportion of households using basic sanitation services - one of the most effective measures for preventing diarrhoea and other life-threatening diseases.

column6: % of users considering basic WASH services to be functional in the target facilities
column7: % d'utilisateurs considérant que les services EHA de base sont fonctionnels dans les installations ciblées
column10: This indicator measures the proportion of the target facilities’ users (such as health centres’ patients or schools’ students) that consider the facilities’ basic WASH services to be functional (in terms of its quality, quantity and access).

column6: number of people having access to basic hygiene items
column7: nombre de personnes ayant accès à des articles d'hygiène de base
column10: The indicator assesses the number of the target population having access to essential hygiene items as defined by the relevant Sphere Standard.

column6: % of schools with facilities providing girls with sufficient privacy to wash themselves and to use their menstrual hygiene materials
column7: % d'écoles dotées d'installations permettant aux filles d'avoir une intimité suffisante pour se laver et utiliser leur matériel d'hygiène menstruelle
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of schools with appropriate menstrual hygiene facilities. Such facilities allow girls to spend more time in school and to feel more comfortable and self-confident.

column6: % of children aged 8 - 23/ 59 months with diarrhoea in the last two weeks who were given additional fluids
column7: % d'enfants âgés de 8 à 23/59 mois souffrant de diarrhée au cours des deux dernières semaines qui ont reçu des liquides supplémentaires
column10: Dehydration is among the major diarrhoea-related risks. However, many caregivers mistakenly believe that children with diarrhoea should drink less. This indicator assesses the proportion of caregivers following the correct practice.

column6: % of children aged 8 - 23/ 59 months with diarrhoea in the last two weeks who were given the same amount of food or more food
column7: % d'enfants âgés de 8 à 23/59 mois souffrant de diarrhée au cours des deux dernières semaines et recevant la même quantité ou plus de nourriture
column10: Diarrhoea increases the risk of a child becoming malnourished. It is therefore important that the usual feeding is continued (and increased during recovery). This indicator assesses the proportion of caregivers following the correct practice.

column6: % of children aged 8 - 23/ 59 months with diarrhoea in the last 2 weeks who were treated with correctly made oral rehydration solution (ORS)
column7: % d'enfants âgés de 8 à 23 /59 mois atteints de diarrhée au cours des 2 dernières semaines qui ont été traités avec une solution de réhydratation orale (SRO) correctement préparée
column10: The indicator measures the proportion of children with diarrhoea who were treated with ORS either purchased in a sachet or prepared at home according to local health professionals' recommendations (usually 6 level teaspoons of sugar and 1/2 level teaspoon of salt dissolved in 1 liter of drinking water).

column5: Appropriate Treatment of Diarrhoea - Recognition of Warning Signs
column6: % of caregivers which can specify at least 3 situations when a child suffering from diarrhoea needs to be taken to a health facility
column7: % de gardiens d’enfants qui peuvent spécifier au moins 3 situations où un enfant souffrant de diarrhée doit être conduit dans un établissement de santé
column10: Several warning signs indicate when home treatment of diarrhoea is insufficient and a child must be taken to a health facility. The indicator measures the proportion of caregivers aware of at least 3 out of 5 to 6 key warning signs.

column6: % of respondents which can within one minute bring and show a soap from their dwelling
column7: % des répondants qui peuvent, en une minute, apporter et montrer un savon de leur habitation
column10: Washing hands with soap is the most effective way of preventing life-threatening diarrhoeal diseases. The indicator therefore assesses the proportion of households having soap available for their use.

column5: Handwashing Facilities With Soap and Water
column6: % of households with handwashing facilities with soap and water at home
column7: % de ménages ayant un lieu désigné pour le lavage des mains où l'eau et le savon sont présents
column10: Existing research shows that people with access to a handwashing facility are more likely to wash their hands. Furthermore, observation of handwashing materials by surveyors represents a more reliable proxy for measuring handwashing behaviour than asking individuals to report their own behaviour. This indicator therefore assesses the proportion of households with handwashing facilities with soap and water at home.

column6: number or % of students who received hygiene education as part of the school curriculum
column7: nombre ou % d'élèves ayant reçu une formation en hygiène dans le cadre du programme scolaire
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion and number of children who were taught by their teachers the essential hygiene-related practices and knowledge as a part of the standard school curriculum (i.e. not as a part of an externally-driven, one-off initiative).

column6: % of WASH promoters that passed both theoretical and practical test
column7: % des promoteurs EHA qui ont réussi à la fois les tests théoriques et pratiques
column10: The indicator assesses the proportion of persons responsible for promoting hygiene/ water /sanitation-related behaviours that have the required knowledge and skills. The "promoters" can be volunteers, health workers but also school teachers or other influential community members.

column6:
Percentage of HH having access to a functioning handwashing facility with water and 
soap at home and essential hygiene items including menstrual hygiene products
column7:
Pourcentage de ménages ayant accès à un poste de lavage des mains en état de marche avec de l’eau et du savon à domicile ainsi qu’à des articles d’hygiène essentiels, comme notamment 
des produits d’hygiè
column10: To measure outcomes of Cash & Voucher Assistance (CVA) related to WASH, more specifically hygiene

column6: % of respondents who know at least 3 out of 5 key moments for hand washing
column7: % des répondants qui connaissent au moins 3 des 5 moments clés pour le lavage des mains
column10: Although awareness often does not lead to action, it still is an important step towards behaviour change. This indicator therefore assesses whether people are aware of at least 3 out of 5 times when washing hands is most important.

column5: Indicator 10b from the results framework water (IGG-DGIS)
column6: Number of people reached with water governance interventions aimed at river basins and deltas with good water quality and quantity
column7: Nombre de personnes atteints par des interventions de gouvernance de l'eau visant les bassins versants et les deltas avec une bonne qualité et quantité d'eau.
column10:
Water is an important factor for development, which requires enough water of good quality and quantity for all users throughout the year. It is important that everyone has access to sufficient water of good quality and is protected against water related disasters. Additionally, it is essential to safeguard biodiversity and to protect and restore water-related ecosystems.
Each person is only counted once, and results of different years can be aggregated to account for the total number of hectares.

column6: Number of people reached with physical interventions aimed at river basins and deltas with good water quality and quantity
column7: Nombre de personnes atteints par des interventions physiques visant les bassins versants et les deltas avec une bonne qualité et quantité d'eau.
